# SQLON AI Database Operations Platform

> SQLON is an evidence-driven AI database operations platform for DBAs and SREs. It exposes 104+ Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, compiles in-memory catalog join graphs to eliminate LLM schema hallucinations, and enforces 33 fail-closed static SQL guardrails.

## Core Value Propositions
- **Zero Schema Hallucination**: SQLON loads dataset JSON metadata into memory, building candidate column indexes and join graphs before any SQL is generated.
- **104+ MCP Tools & Resources**: Implements Anthropic's Model Context Protocol over stdio and HTTP transports for integration with Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, VS Code, and custom AI agents.
- **Multi-DBMS Compatibility**: Pure-Go native execution engine supporting PostgreSQL (v12-v16), MySQL (v8.x), MariaDB (v10.x/v11.x), and Oracle DB (via `sqlon-oracle`).
- **Fail-Closed Security**: AST-level SQL validation against 33 security guardrails, mandatory read-only transaction locks (`tx_read_only=1`), and approval-gated change control workflows.
- **Fleet Observation & SRE Intelligence**: Active session profiling, index advisors, deadlock diagnostics, and OpenMetadata lineage synchronization.
